clue.text: He should be able to deal with one's basic problems

definitions.text: He should be able to deal with one's basic problems

parts.words: He should be able to deal with one's basic problems
parts.note: the feet are the base of the body, so 'basic problems' are foot complaints, treated by a chiropodist

explanation.surface: A counsellor or fixer who tackles people's fundamental difficulties.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Basic' seems to mean fundamental, but it means at the base: the feet.
explanation.definitionFit: A chiropodist treats corns, nails and other foot troubles, the lowest part of a person.

clue.text: A little jacket only suitable for school

indicators.note: A little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A short jacket that is only fit to be worn to school.
explanation.definitionFit: Eton is a famous English public school, so the name belongs with school.

clue.text: Mean at home, nurse is

parts.note: in means at home, as in 'staying in'
to nurse is to tend a patient

explanation.surface: Someone is unkind while at home, and a nurse too.
explanation.definitionFit: To mean to do something is to plan or purpose it.

clue.text: Not flaunted in a rude fashion

indicators.note: 'in a rude fashion' tells us the preceding letters are worked into a new shape

explanation.surface: Something kept modest rather than shown off crudely.
explanation.definitionFit: Something not aired has not been displayed or shown publicly.

clue.text: One turned to a Greek character

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

indicators.note: turned says the little word beside it is flipped round end to end

explanation.surface: Someone who has taken up the role of a figure from Greece.
explanation.definitionFit: Iota is the ninth letter of the Greek alphabet, a character in the written sense.

clue.text: Dog making mistake brought into line

indicators.note: brought into says one piece is set inside the other

parts.note: a tier is a row or line, as of seats
to err is to make a mistake

explanation.surface: A dog misbehaves when it is made to stand in a queue.
explanation.definitionFit: A terrier is a small breed of hound originally bred to hunt burrowing animals.

clue.text: Go in a hotel for a change it can be divine

indicators.note: for a change says the letters of the phrase before it are altered into a different order

explanation.surface: Popping into a hotel as a treat can feel heavenly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for a change' rearranges GO IN A HOTEL; 'divine' is a noun here, a clergyman scholar, and 'it can be' leads to it.
explanation.definitionFit: A divine is a churchman learned in religion, a scholar of doctrine.

clue.text: Manual worker, a good man, with a single graduate son

parts.note: a saint is a good man, abbreviated St
a single means one
MA, Master of Arts, is a graduate
taken as written

explanation.surface: A labourer, a decent fellow, with an only son who has a degree.
explanation.definitionFit: A mason shapes stone by hand, a skilled craftsman.

clue.text: Talk about cover

parts.note: c, for circa, means about
a hat is a head covering

explanation.surface: A discussion about insurance protection.
explanation.definitionFit: To chat is to converse informally.

clue.text: After many a bloomer this will be made official

parts.note: post is Latin for after, as in postwar
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, a large number
an aster is a flower, something that blooms

explanation.surface: After a gardener's many blunders he will be given a formal title.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bloomer' sounds like a mistake but here means a flowering plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A postmaster is the official in charge of a post office.

clue.text: Hopeless bore, joining the Navy, is starting a new life

indicators.note: hopeless suggests the word beside it is botched and put together wrongly

parts.note: RN is the Royal Navy

explanation.surface: A dreary fellow enlists as a sailor to begin afresh.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone reborn has begun again, with a fresh existence.

clue.text: The workman came first, it's felt

parts.note: a hand is a manual worker, as in farmhand
led means came first, was in front

explanation.surface: The worker took the lead and emotion was felt.
explanation.definitionFit: Something felt has been touched or handled by the fingers.

clue.text: A long-legged creature, one gathers

explanation.definitionFit: A harvestman is a spindly arachnid like a daddy-long-legs, and also a farm labourer who reaps crops.

clue.text: The Tory won constituents, that's deserving of attention

indicators.note: constituents suggests the parts of the phrase are taken apart and recombined

explanation.surface: A Conservative's election victory in his seat merits notice.
explanation.walkthrough: 'constituents' rearranges THE TORY WON; 'that's' leads to the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something remarkable merits notice and comment.

clue.text: Acts about soft drugs

indicators.note: about says one piece goes around the other

parts.note: does means acts or performs
p, piano, is soft in music

explanation.surface: Laws concerning cannabis.
explanation.definitionFit: To dope someone is to sedate them with narcotics.

clue.text: Play for a group of schoolchildren

parts.note: per means for a, as in pounds per hour
a form is a school class

explanation.surface: A drama staged for a school class.
explanation.definitionFit: To play a part or tune is to act or render it.

clue.text: Money for keeping stray dogs

explanation.definitionFit: The pound is the British currency unit, and also an enclosure where strays are held.

clue.text: Benefactor presenting a fellow with gold

parts.note: a don is a university fellow
or is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A charitable patron gives an academic some gold.
explanation.definitionFit: A donor gives money or goods, a giver.

clue.text: Value mid-afternoon tea-break

indicators.note: mid picks out the centre letter of the word after it
break suggests the letters before it are smashed and reformed

explanation.surface: Someone appreciates a pause for a cuppa halfway through the day.
explanation.definitionFit: To rate something is to assess or esteem it.

clue.text: A girl to avoid

explanation.definitionFit: A miss is a young unmarried woman, and to miss something is to escape or steer clear of it.

clue.text: Some complaints lessen, naturally, with the use of an aperient

indicators.note: some says only a portion of the following words is used, the letters lying inside them

explanation.surface: Some ailments ease without fuss when one takes a laxative.
explanation.definitionFit: Senna is a plant-derived laxative, a classic purgative.

clue.text: Economical resort to get around

parts.note: a spa is a health resort
to ring is to encircle

explanation.surface: A thrifty holiday destination that is easy to travel round.
explanation.definitionFit: Sparing means frugal, using little.

clue.text: A Roundhead enemy's appearance

parts.note: the head of the word round is its first letter, R
a rival is an enemy or opponent; the 's is 'is'

explanation.surface: A Parliamentarian foe turns up in the Civil War.
explanation.walkthrough: A Roundhead was a Parliamentary soldier in the English Civil War; here it is read as 'head of Round'.
explanation.definitionFit: An arrival is someone's coming, their turning up.

clue.text: Covers all points about strike

indicators.note: about says one piece goes around another

parts.note: E, N, W and S are all four compass points
a rap is a knock or strike

explanation.surface: Something protects every spot around a hit.
explanation.definitionFit: To enwrap is to wrap up or enfold.

clue.text: Taken from jumble and worn

indicators.note: jumble suggests mixing up the letters of the words beside it

explanation.surface: Clothes picked up from a second-hand sale and worn.
explanation.walkthrough: A jumble sale is a British charity sale of second-hand goods; 'jumble' rearranges AND WORN.
explanation.definitionFit: Resources drawn on are taken or used from a supply.

clue.text: Continue to feel a need for sport

parts.note: to want is to feel a need
on means continuing, as in carry on

explanation.surface: A craving for games persists.
explanation.definitionFit: Wanton cruelty is gratuitous, done merely for fun.

clue.text: Artistic man responsible for revolution?

explanation.definitionFit: J M W Turner was a celebrated English painter, and someone who works a lathe makes it spin round.

clue.text: Article on unknown author

parts.note: an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A piece written about a writer nobody can identify.
explanation.definitionFit: Anon., for anonymous, credits a writer whose name is unknown.

clue.text: Care for nothing

explanation.definitionFit: To love is to cherish someone, and love is zero in tennis scoring.

clue.text: Modernisation of hotel bringing acclaim

parts.note: an inn is a small hotel
an ovation is applause, acclaim

explanation.surface: A hotel's refurbishment wins applause.
explanation.definitionFit: Innovation is the introduction of new methods, updating.

clue.text: Writing a note, a guy can given pain

parts.note: C is a musical note
he is any guy, a male

explanation.surface: A man writing a musical note can cause suffering.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces are written down in turn: A, then C, then HE.
explanation.definitionFit: An ache is a dull, persistent hurt.

clue.text: An American criminal, comfortable in retirement and idle

indicators.note: in retirement suggests going backwards, withdrawing, so the word is read in reverse

parts.note: snug means cosy and comfortable
to linger is to dawdle, idle

explanation.surface: A US outlaw who has retired to a cosy, lazy life.
explanation.definitionFit: A gunslinger was a Wild West gunfighter or outlaw.
